opportunities.name: End-to-end city weekend trip planning
opportunities.description: For a given city, dates, party size, activity interests and cuisine: look up the city on Wikipedia, check the weather on timeanddate, find a hotel on Booking.com, find activities on Viator, find a restaurant on OpenTable, save a summary note, and draft an email to a companion.
opportunities.site: wikipedia.org, timeanddate.com, booking.com, viator.com, opentable.com, notes app, mail app
steps: Search Wikipedia for {city} and note the population
Search timeanddate for {city} and note the current temperature
On Booking.com, search {city} for {check_in}-{check_out} with {adults} adults and note the top hotel and price
On Viator, search {activity_1} and {activity_2} and note the top result for each
On OpenTable, search '{city} {cuisine}' for {check_in} at 20:00 for {adults} people and note the top restaurant and a time slot
Add a note: '{city} {dates}: pop X, temp, hotel, activities, dinner'
Compose an email to {recipient} with the subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a plan summary in the body

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15 2026, 2 adults, Thames boat + Tower of London, Indian (Benares), maya@example.com
Dublin, Dec 4-6 2026, 3 adults, Guinness Storehouse + Cliffs of Moher, seafood (SOLE), tom@example.com
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17 2027, 2 adults, whisky tasting + Highlands day trip, Scottish (Evergreen), priya@example.com

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for hotels in a destination for given dates and number of adults, then read the top result's name and price.
steps: Dismiss the cookie or sign-in popups if shown
Type {destination} and pick the first suggestion
Open the date picker and select {check_in} and {check_out}
Adjust the adult count to {adults} and click Done
Click Search and read the top hotel's name and price

instances.values: London, Nov 13-15, 2 adults → Club Quarters Hotel London City €445
Dublin, Dec 4-6, 3 adults → Ashling Hotel Dublin €453
Edinburgh, Jan 15-17, 2 adults → The Haymarket Hotel €180

opportunities.name: Viator activity searches
opportunities.description: Search Viator for one or more activity keywords and record the top result for each.
steps: Reject cookies if prompted
Click the search box and type {activity query}
Choose 'Search for {query}' or the matching place suggestion
Read the top result card's title and price
Repeat for the next activity query

instances.values: Thames boat London; Tower of London
Guinness Storehouse Dublin; Cliffs of Moher Dublin
whisky tasting Edinburgh; Highlands day trip Edinburgh

opportunities.name: OpenTable restaurant search
opportunities.description: Search OpenTable for '{city} {cuisine}' on a given date for N people and note the top restaurant and its earliest time slot.
steps: Reject non-essential cookies if prompted
Type '{city} {cuisine}' in the location/restaurant field
Open the date picker, go to the right month and select {date}
Set the party size to {people}
Click Find a table / Let's go
Read the top result and its first time slot (e.g. 19:30)

instances.values: Dublin seafood, 4 Dec 2026, 3 people → SOLE Seafood & Grill 19:30
Edinburgh Scottish, 15 Jan 2027, 2 people → Evergreen Bar & Kitchen 19:30

opportunities.name: Compose trip summary email
opportunities.description: Draft an email to a recipient with the subject '{city} weekend {dates}' and a body summarising the hotel, activities and dinner.
steps: Open New message
Fill To with {recipient}
Fill Subject '{city} weekend {dates}'
Fill Body 'Hi {name}, plan: hotel {hotel} (€{price}), {activities}, dinner at {restaurant} ({cuisine}) on {date}.'
Click Send or Discard

opportunities.name: timeanddate city weather lookup
opportunities.description: Search timeanddate for a city and open its weather page to read the current temperature.
steps: Click the site search (or the World Clock search box)
Type {city} and submit
Open the city's Weather link from the results
Read the current temperature

opportunities.name: Wikipedia city lookup
opportunities.description: Search Wikipedia for a city, open its article and read the population.
steps: Click the Wikipedia search box
Type {city}
Select the first suggestion (the capital city)
Read the population from the article

opportunities.name: Add trip summary note
opportunities.description: Add a new note line in the Notes app summarising a city trip plan.
steps: Click the New note field
Type '{city} {dates}: pop X, temp, hotel, activities, dinner {restaurant} {time}'
Press Enter to save
